title: Tree-based solution representations for quadratic bilinear systems and their consequences in model order reduction
summary: We investigate quadratic bilinear systems by developing novel tree-based representations of their solutions. The proposed framework decomposes the solution into a sequence of coupled bilinear subsystems whose components admit explicit expansions indexed by full binary trees. These representations yield sufficient conditions for the existence of global solutions and lead to new output bounds in terms of reachability Gramians.
